title: Saltmarsh Light: The Snuffed Beacon
description: The lighthouse lamp went dark just before midnight and a coaster ran aground on the reef. Three souls were on the rock that night. Climb the stair, mind the oil, and let the evidence — not assumptions — name a suspect.

truth.summary: Finn, pressed by the harbormaster over debts he could never repay, drew the spare brass key from his coat, emptied the oil store into a jerrycan to sell ashore, and snuffed the beacon around 23:40. The undamaged store lock, his debts, and Corwin's sighting converge on him. Odda's oily prints are a red herring: she climbed to trim the wick at dusk, then spent the night kneading bread in the galley, flour to the elbows the whole time.
timeline: 22:00 - Odda climbs to the lamp room, trims the wick, and descends to the galley.
22:30 - Corwin locks the oil store with the master key and walks the causeway.
23:10 - Finn takes the spare brass key from his coat in the bunkroom.
23:40 - Finn empties the oil store and snuffs the beacon. The lamp goes dark.
23:45 - The coaster Venture grounds on the reef; the alarm bell rings.
23:50 - Corwin reaches the lamp room and sees Finn on the stair.
